page.overview:
Who is Dust titan?

The dust titan, known by other names such as the Rolling Danger or the Thunder that Comes, is an elemental titan composed of dust, sand, and cyclonic winds.

The dust titan had two eyes of perpetual green glow, and a huge body whose winds carried elements of its environment. In addition to its titanic, sandstone-like form, this primordial was capable of taking on the appearance of a tornado.

The dust titan was very aggressive, and relentless while chasing a target.

The dust titan was one of the primordials, ancient beings of chaotic elemental power that existed before the Exandrian Founding. At some point this specific titan began to prowl the plane of Pandemonium, using its power to attack and destroy life forms and their buildings, such as a citadel made of dark metal.
